the page shows no fee and staff can still book

in the future and not overlapping a Scheduled appointment

findings.suggested_fix: Add S-3 ACs: a past slot on today's date and a time outside the doctor's availability are not offered as free with the fee shown; restore 'in the future' in C6.
findings.text: REQ-11 (booking rules unchanged) is tested only for the overlap partition. The rule also requires a slot to be inside availability and in the future; no AC checks a past slot or a slot outside availability stays non-free, and C6 drops 'in the future'.

cites.quote: every other field, label and button is present and works as before this change

findings.suggested_fix: Name the page's existing fields (Patient, Doctor, date, slot, reason, Book) in the AC.
findings.text: S-4 AC3 checks that 'every other field, label and button' works as before without naming them, so it is hard to check precisely and a missing element could slip by.

cites.quote: The rest of the page stays as it was and shows no private data

findings.suggested_fix: Split S-4 into a page-unchanged story and a no-private-data story.
findings.text: S-4 bundles two different outcomes: regression of the slot list/page (REQ-8, REQ-12) and no private data shown (REQ-13, REQ-14).

rubric_items.reason: All 14 known REQs in req.md are traced by S-1 to S-4; no assumed or unknown REQs exist.
S-1 to S-3 each hold one outcome; S-4 bundles unchanged slot list, unchanged rest of page and two privacy constraints.
ACs are Given/When/Then and mostly discriminating (lakh grouping, zero fee, stale fee on load failure), but REQ-11 covers only the overlap partition of the booking rules, and S-4 AC3 is broad.
Fee values come from REQ-2/REQ-5 or are derived inline (divide by 100, Indian grouping) from the glossary Paise entry.
Clear, consistent terms (paise, Consultation fee, Scheduled, free slot) matching the intent and glossary.
